task: Consolidate advance requests and settlement review into one canonical office workspace, then deploy the demo environment.
acceptanceCriteria: One finance navigation entry opens Tạm ứng & hoàn ứng
Requests and settlements remain available as durable query-backed views
The legacy settlement URL redirects while preserving non-focus query state
Trung tâm phê duyệt remains a separate authority workspace
Existing role, financial, settlement, and governance contracts are unchanged
Desktop and mobile views have no page-level horizontal overflow
Affected automated, review, deploy, and live browser gates pass
publicContracts: /governance-actions remains the final governance authority queue
ADMIN and MANAGER can submit advance proposals; ACCOUNTANT remains read-only on advance requests

blastRadius: Office finance navigation and browser titles

scoutSummary: The source pages overlapped in navigation but not accounting authority: advance requests create governance proposals, ordinary settlement review mutates the settlement directly, and the governance center applies governed decisions. The implementation consolidates information architecture without changing APIs, database rows, ledger calculations, or RBAC.
